reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies E:09 as a heating fault in the circulation pump heater, offers the isolated multimeter resistance test with a sensible safety caveat, interprets the open circuit result properly, and lays out the DIY pump replacement against replacement for a 9-year-old machine. Conversation 2 is garbled and templated, forbids the safe isolated test contradictorily, invents a £100-150 cost with no basis, asks about model it already knew, and advises replacement without confirming the heater fault. Conversation 1 could have stressed engineer escalation and the advanced nature of the pump swap more, but it is far more useful and honest overall.
